title: Japan Cultural Trails Group Tour
alt: The Chureito pagoda with Mount Fuji behind it, Japan
transport: Coaches, bullet trains and guided touring throughout

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large four star hotel beside Shinagawa station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights beside Shinagawa station, with free time in Shinjuku and a full guided city day.

stops.name: Kawaguchiko
stops.subtitle: Kawaguchiko to Mount Fuji
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Lakeside resort with Mount Fuji across the water on a clear day

activities.name: Arakurayama Sengen park and shrine
activities.description: The four hundred steps up to the Chureito pagoda, where the pagoda, the cherry trees and Mount Fuji line up in one frame.

activities.name: Lake Kawaguchi boat ride
activities.description: A cruise out onto the lake, with the mountain reflected in the water when the cloud lifts.

activities.name: Mount Fuji fifth station
activities.description: Up the mountain road to the fifth station at 2,300 metres, where the treeline ends and the climbing trail begins.

program.name: Kawaguchiko
program.description: A lakeside night below Mount Fuji, with the Chureito pagoda, a boat ride and the drive up to the fifth station.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.subtitle: Kyoto to Shiraito falls and Nagoya
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel opposite Kyoto station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Iyashi no Sato Nenba village
activities.description: A rebuilt village of thatched farmhouses below Mount Fuji, now craft workshops where you can try dyeing or pottery.

activities.name: Shiraito falls
activities.description: A two hundred metre curtain of spring water falling in white threads, fed by the snowmelt off Mount Fuji.

activities.name: Toyota museum
activities.description: The commemorative museum in Nagoya, which runs from the first looms to the cars, with machines you can watch working.

activities.name: Kyoto sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the old capital, taking in the golden pavilion, a Zen garden and the torii gate paths above Fushimi.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: Two nights by Kyoto station, reached through the Fuji foothills and Nagoya, with a full guided day and a free evening in Gion.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Nara
stops.hotel: Holiday Inn Express Osaka City Centre - Midosuji, an IHG Hotel
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Straightforward hotel on Midosuji, walking distance to Dotonbori

activities.name: Nara sightseeing with Todai-ji and Horyu-ji
activities.description: Todai-ji, which holds the great bronze Buddha, and Horyu-ji, the oldest wooden building standing anywhere in the world.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: A night in Osaka, reached through Nara's great temples, with free time in the Dotonbori food streets.

stops.name: Okayama
stops.subtitle: Okayama to Himeji
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Smart hotel beside Okayama station, near the Korakuen garden

activities.name: Himeji castle
activities.description: The white heron castle, the finest surviving fortress in Japan and the first site here to be listed by UNESCO.

activities.name: Okayama sightseeing tour
activities.description: The Korakuen garden, counted among the three great gardens of Japan, and the black keep of Okayama castle beside it.

program.name: Okayama
program.description: A night in Okayama, with Himeji castle on the way and the Korakuen garden in the afternoon.

stops.name: Hiroshima
stops.subtitle: Hiroshima to Kurashiki and Miyajima
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in the centre, walking distance from the park

activities.name: Kurashiki canal quarter
activities.description: Free time in the old merchant quarter, where white walled storehouses line a willow canal that still has punts on it.

activities.name: Hiroshima walking tour
activities.description: On foot through the Peace Memorial Park, the cenotaph and the A-Bomb Dome with a guide who tells the city's story properly.

activities.name: Miyajima island
activities.description: The ferry across to Miyajima for the floating torii gate, Itsukushima shrine and the tame deer along the shore.

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: A last night in Hiroshima, with the canal quarter at Kurashiki on the way and the island shrine at Miyajima the same day.

Transfer to the station or the airport for your journey home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Sleeping at Kawaguchiko is the difference between seeing Fuji and waiting for it. You get the morning window as well as the afternoon.
expert.tip: Carry a small overnight bag for the one night stops. The coach handles the big cases, but you will thank yourself at Kawaguchiko and Okayama.

summary: Nine days west across the country: Tokyo, a lakeside night below Mount Fuji with the Chureito pagoda and the fifth station, two nights in Kyoto, Nara's great temples and Osaka, Himeji castle and Okayama, then Hiroshima with Kurashiki and Miyajima.
included: Included: 8 nights across six towns with daily breakfast; coaches and bullet trains throughout; guided sightseeing in Tokyo, Kyoto, Nara, Okayama and Hiroshima; Arakurayama Sengen park, a Lake Kawaguchi boat ride and the Mount Fuji fifth station; Iyashi no Sato Nenba, Shiraito falls and the Toyota museum; Himeji castle; free time at Kurashiki and Dotonbori; the ferry to Miyajima island.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
